mu_name_from: OURS. Group 13 number 25 is free in 0.75 (later MU's own jewellery numbers, whose art this tree does not have). The name says its signature power. docs/jewellery.md, 'Powers'.
why_this_one: The powered rings and pendants (the user, 2026-10-03: 'lets make new rings and pendats, which make sense from classical ARPG experience, like exp gain, zen gain'). Its signature: Critical damage, +2% at +0 to +12% at +9 over the top of the band. Up to three more powers roll at the drop; how many is its colour.
profile_note: As Gem05: a small painted sheet on a made object seen close.

stats.note: Ours, on MU's jewellery row: a 1x1 piece, durability 50, every class, level asked its drop level.
stats.power: Critical damage, +2% at +0 to +12% at +9 over the top of the band.
